signal: Stampli was named to G2's 2026 Best Software Awards across three categories and is expanding from AP automation into AI procure-to-pay

email.body1:
Joe, saw Stampli land three G2 2026 Best Software lists and expand from AP automation into AI procure-to-pay.

A broader platform usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Stampli off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Joe, quick follow-up for Stampli.

With procure-to-pay opening fresh demand, most sales-strategy teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and by then it is a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Stampli needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Joe, last bit of proof for Stampli.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Stampli's reply rate likely compares to other fintech sellers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Joe, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Expanding into procure-to-pay makes for a busy stretch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to Stampli either way.
